principle: July is development. Candidate filters use only information available at or before each signal and rolling past-only same-ticker factor history. August is locked until this file is committed.

common_execution.entry: next exact one-minute bar open after the raw family signal
common_execution.missing_minute_policy: fail closed; no interpolation or substitute bars
common_execution.rolling_history: previous 10 eligible raw signals from the same ticker and same base family, strictly before the current signal timestamp
common_execution.rolling_benchmark: simple arithmetic mean of each factor over those previous 10 raw signals

ETF_H1_ORB15_CONTEXT_V1.raw_signal: unchanged from the original frozen H1 definition
ETF_H1_ORB15_CONTEXT_V1.factor_pass: current factor strictly greater than its same-factor rolling mean over the previous 10 eligible raw H1 signals for that ticker
ETF_H1_ORB15_CONTEXT_V1.context_filter: at least 3 of the 4 factors pass

ETF_H2_VWAP_REVERSION_CONTEXT_V1.raw_signal: unchanged from the original frozen H2 definition
ETF_H2_VWAP_REVERSION_CONTEXT_V1.factor_pass: current factor strictly greater than its same-factor rolling mean over the previous 10 eligible raw H2 signals for that ticker

primary_metrics: net win rate after 2 bps friction
net expectancy bps per trade after 2 bps
MFE conditional on positive fixed-exit direction

forbidden_after_freeze: change number of required aligned factors
exclude a ticker because of August results
change the entry or time exit
adopt a stop or target selected from August
inspect August and then create a rescue variant under the same candidate ID
